## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person / Contact** — core entity; fields visible: name, stage, created date, last visit date, last communication date, last text received date, phone number(s), tags, assigned agent
- **Smart List** — saved filter set with ID (list ID 37), name ("All Expireds"), a contact count badge, columns configuration, and filter criteria
- **Tag** — many-to-many with contacts; values seen: "compliance" (excluded), "Unsubscribed" (excluded), "Expired" (included), additional tag-based values. Tags are text strings.
- **Stage** — enum field on contact; values seen: "Expired", "Expired Listing", "Active C..." (Active Client implied)
- **Agent** — user/broker entity; "Matt Ryan" is a filterable agent
- **Communication** — generic last-communication timestamp spanning all channels
- **Text Message** — separate trackable entity; has "last received" timestamp and preview text; linked to contact
- **Phone Number** — linked to contact; has quality flag ("Phone is good") and capability flags (SMS-capable = purple icon, voice-capable = green icon)
- **Column Definitions** — configurable per smart list view; organized into categories: Details, Assigned, Emails, Calls, Texts, Website activity, Deals, Inbox Apps, Custom Fields

### Field Types / Enum Values
- **Stage values observed:** "Expired", "Expired Listing", "Active C..." (Active Client/Clients)
- **Tag values observed:** "compliance", "Unsubscribed", "Expired" — tags are free-form strings, comma-separated in filter display
- **Phone quality:** boolean "Phone is good" — either verified/good or not
- **Phone capability:** binary indicators — can-call (green), can-SMS (purple)
- **Date fields:** Stored as timestamps, displayed as relative ("7 months ago") or formatted ("Nov 15th '25", "Dec 27th '25")

### Relationships
- Contact → many Tags
- Contact → one Stage
- Contact → one assigned Agent
- Contact → many Phone Numbers (with capability metadata)
- Contact → many Text Messages
- Contact → Last Communication (cross-channel aggregate timestamp)
- Smart List → many Filter Criteria
- Smart List → Column Configuration

```jsx
            </NameCell>
            <DateCell>{contact.createdAt}</DateCell>
            <DateCell>{contact.lastVisit}</DateCell>
            <DateCell>{contact.lastCommunication}</DateCell>
            <TextPreviewCell>
              {contact.lastTextReceived && (
                <>
                  <RelativeTime>{contact.lastTextReceived}</RelativeTime>
                  <TextPreview>{contact.lastTextPreview}</TextPreview>
                </>
              )}
            </TextPreviewCell>
            <PhoneCell>
              {contact.phones.map(phone => (
                <PhoneEntry key={phone.number}>
                  <PhoneIcon callable={phone.callable} onClick={() => dialContact(contact, phone)} />
                  {phone.smsCapable && <SmsIcon onClick={() => openSms(contact, phone)} />}
                  <PhoneNumber>{phone.formattedNumber}</PhoneNumber>
                </PhoneEntry>
              ))}
            </PhoneCell>
          </ContactRow>
        ))}
      </ContactsTable>
      
      <Pagination 
        currentPage={currentPage}
        totalPages={Math.ceil(417/34)}
        onPrev={...}
        onNext={...}
      />
    </TableArea>
    
    <FilterPanel open={true} filterCount={7}>
      <FilterSearch placeholder="Add a filter" />
      <ActiveFilterList>
        <FilterItem icon="tag" label="Tags exclude any of: compliance..." expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="clock" label="Last Communication more than..." expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="stage" label="Stage excludes any of: Active C..." expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="phone" label="Phone is good" expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="tag" label="Tags exclude any of: Unsubscri..." expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="person" label="Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan" expandable />
        <FilterItem icon="tag" label="Tags include any of: Expired, wi..." expandable />
      </ActiveFilterList>
      <ClearFiltersButton>Clear filters</ClearFiltersButton>
    </FilterPanel>
  </MainContent>
  
  <HelpWidget />
</PeoplePage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic Notes

1. **Smart List badge count vs "Showing N people":** The badge "417" in the left rail is the total count of contacts matching the smart list's filter criteria. "Showing 34 people" in the content header indicates the current page result count (34 per page, paginated across 417 total). These can diverge from each other.

2. **Columns picker two-pane architecture:** The dropdown is a controlled two-pane flyout. Left pane is a category nav; hovering or clicking a category loads its columns in the right pane. The "Calls" category is expanded in this screenshot showing 7 sub-columns — these are distinct metrics about phone call activity stored per-contact.

3. **Phone icon meanings:** Green phone circle = "phone is good" (validated, not DNC, can call). Purple SMS circle = "SMS capable" (the number accepts texts). These map to the "Phone is good" filter and indicate which contacts cleared the "Phone is good" filter. Not all contacts in this filtered list show both icons — the phone quality may apply to the primary phone while SMS capability is per-number.

4. **Stage tag positioning:** Stage tag ("Expired Listing", "Expired") appears as a small colored pill beneath the contact name within the Name cell — not in a separate column. This is a visual affordance to show pipeline position at a glance within the name cell itself.

5. **"Last Text Received" preview text:** The preview text shown ("Hi, Matt Ryan here -On..." / "Hi, Matt Ryan here with...") appears to be automated outbound text messages that the system records as "sent" texts that appear in the received log — these are likely FUB-automated introduction texts, not truly inbound texts. The column is "Last Text Received" but the preview content appears to be outbound automation.

6. **Filter truncation:** All filter labels are truncated with "..." because the filter panel is ~280px and the filter values can be long. The full value must be visible in the expanded (chevron-opened) state.

7. **"Out Of State Home ..." preset:** This appears to be a named column configuration preset (saved view) rather than a filter. It likely toggles the visible columns to a set relevant to "out of state home buyers" — perhaps showing address, state, or distance-related columns.

8. **Contact name truncation:** Long names like "Whitaker Stone..." and "Chelsea Torrey L..." are truncated with ellipsis — the Name cell has a fixed width and overflow: ellipsis applied.

9. **Company/entity contacts:** Several "contacts" are actually property addresses or company names ("Bench At The Co...", "Frank Properties", "Greg Welch Com...") — FUB allows non-person entities to be stored as people records.

10. **Pagination math:** 417 total / 34 shown per page = ~13 pages of results. The current view appears to be page 1 (most recently created contacts at top due to "Created ↓" sort).
